bug_class: local DM/HLN omits HAC via h-1 at h=1, plain iid variance, iid t-test fallback, or explicit zero bandwidth
materiality_caveat: Exposure is structural, not a proven error. An h=1-degenerate rule is only material when the loss differential is autocorrelated; a NO_HAC site omits serial-covariance correction at every horizon. Confirming materiality requires a re-run and the differential's acf.
